description: This file defines the QR class within the Matrix\Decomposition namespace. It implements QR decomposition using Householder reflections, providing methods to retrieve the Q and R matrices, check for full rank, and solve systems of linear equations using the decomposition.

classes.name: QR
classes.description: Class implementing QR decomposition using Householder reflections.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the QR object with a matrix and performs the decomposition.

methods.name: getHouseholdVectors
methods.description: Returns the Householder vectors as a Matrix.

methods.name: getQ
methods.description: Constructs and returns the orthogonal matrix Q from the decomposition.

methods.name: getR
methods.description: Constructs and returns the upper triangular matrix R from the decomposition.

methods.name: hypo
methods.description: Calculates the Euclidean norm of two numbers in a numerically stable way.

methods.name: decompose
methods.description: Performs the QR decomposition using Householder reflections.

methods.name: isFullRank
methods.description: Checks if the matrix is of full rank based on the R diagonal elements.

methods.name: solve
methods.description: Solves the linear system A*X = B using the QR decomposition.
